what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan living in Kenya.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 202772 South Sudanese refugees in Kenya, 8.5% of all South Sudanese refugees.
Uganda, Sudan and Ethiopia host more.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021 and again in 2025, at war level in 2014.
The groups fighting the government include the SPLM/A - IO, which UCDP also lists in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Kenya rose from 16774 in 2012 to 202772 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025, after a big change between 2013 and 2014.
Returns from Kenya to South Sudan were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Kenya only.
People displaced inside South Sudan are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Kenya they live.
